overview: Limit ka matlab: x kisi value ke paas jaaye to f(x) kis value ke paas jaata hai. GATE me indeterminate forms (0/0, inf/inf), standard limits (sin x / x, (1+1/x)^x), L'Hopital rule aur squeeze/bounded-function arguments aate hain.
whyItMatters: 15 PYQs, 1993-2025; almost sabhi NAT/MCQ me ek hi calculation-type sawal.
coreConcept: Pehle direct substitution try karo. Agar 0/0 ya inf/inf aaye to L'Hopital rule (numerator aur denominator ka alag alag derivative) ya standard limit use karo.
hinglishExplanation: Limit nikaalna = value ke 'kareeb jaana', value par pahunchna nahi. Substitute karke dekho: agar seedha number mil gaya to wahi answer. 0/0 ya inf/inf form indeterminate hai, tab derivative lagao. x -> infinity par bade powers jeetate hain; dono taraf se limit barabar ho tabhi exist karta hai.
formalDefinition: lim f(x) = L agar left-hand aur right-hand limits dono L hon.
importantProperties: Standard: lim sin x / x = 1 (x->0), lim (1 - cos x)/x^2 = 1/2, lim (e^x - 1)/x = 1, lim ln(1+x)/x = 1.
L'Hopital: 0/0 ya inf/inf par lim f/g = lim f'/g'.
Bounded function x vanishing function = 0 (e.g., x sin(1/x) -> 0).
Squeeze theorem: g <= f <= h aur lim g = lim h = L to lim f = L.
x -> inf: polynomial ratio me highest power ka ratio.
Limit exist karta hai <=> left = right.
Rationalise karo jab square roots ka difference aaye (inf - inf).
keyPropertiesAndIdentities: Taylor series bhi kaam karta hai (par kabhi kabhi question 'without power series' bolta hai).
commonPitfalls: Determinate form par bhi L'Hopital lagana.
Left/right limit alag hone par exist maan lena.
